attempted_claim: Let T_n be a uniform type-II triangulation of the sphere with n vertices decorated by critical Bernoulli-1/2 site percolation, with x_n,y_n two independent uniform vertices. Let lambda_n be the discrete percolation exploration from x_n to y_n by iterative chordal peeling with uniform retargeting as sketched in Gwynne-Miller Section 1.4. With graph distance rescaled by const*n^{-1/4}, counting measure by const*n^{-1}, and lambda_n by const*n^{3/4} peeling steps, does the two-pointed curve-decorated metric measure space converge in law in GHPU topology to a doubly-marked Brownian map with two quantum-typical points decorated by conditionally independent whole-plane SLE_6 from x to y in quantum natural time?
decisive_failure: The discrete retargeted exploration lacks a GHPU-parametrized definition and the finite-volume whole-plane SLE_6 in quantum-natural-time limit has no rigorous construction, so neither tightness, identification, nor convergence could be stated or proved within the lane.
